type: Broad job board and recruiting platform
supply_model: Employer posts, distribution and partner network
candidate_experience_observed: Deep filters, quick apply and commute tools; title-led search; very broad result sets
freshness_observed: Date filters exist; single ads commonly run 30 days; subscription jobs can remain until filled
pay_schedule_language: Some salary display; schedule usually in prose; language filter exists
trust_strength: Established employer product and quality rules
business_model_observed: Single Pro ad from EUR 1,449/30 days; starter subscription from EUR 249/month for 12 months
strategic_gap: Expensive for casual SME hiring; not designed around weekly availability; volume can overwhelm

candidate_experience_observed: Large supply, relevance/date sort, easy application on eligible jobs
freshness_observed: Free listings lose visibility with time; policy addresses suspicious, duplicate and expired jobs
pay_schedule_language: Employer-dependent; response-time labels appear on some jobs
trust_strength: Strong integrity policies and employer tooling; sponsored visibility is explicit
business_model_observed: Up to three free posts/month from Dec 2025; sponsored auction/per-started-application models
strategic_gap: Commercial/relevance mix; schedule and contract truth are not the core organizing layer

primary_scope: Local German jobs plus job-seeker ads
supply_model: Private and commercial self-posting plus professional feeds
candidate_experience_observed: Very local and recent; direct message/apply; offers and job requests can mix in one query
freshness_observed: Newest-first option and visible post dates
pay_schedule_language: Highly inconsistent; structured hourly-pay field sometimes available
trust_strength: Large reach and poster history, but attractive easy-money jobs create scam exposure
strategic_gap: Strong local liquidity but inconsistent structure, identity, application route and safety

primary_scope: Student shifts and working-student roles in 40+ German cities
supply_model: Zenjob employs/places students under AÜG and handles administration
candidate_experience_observed: Strong shift selection; app-only onboarding; identity, tax, insurance and student documents required
freshness_observed: Live shift inventory rather than passive ads
pay_schedule_language: Schedule and shift details are core; most roles require good German
trust_strength: Verified worker/employer operations and payroll; heavier accountability
business_model_observed: Employer staffing fees not publicly standardized
strategic_gap: Student-only; high onboarding friction; not a neutral discovery portal; app reviews flag cancellation and communication themes

type: Student staffing, placement and job board
primary_scope: Students, graduates and young professionals across Germany
supply_model: Temporary supply, direct placement and Jobmensa board
candidate_experience_observed: One profile, app applications, document upload, shifts and payroll
freshness_observed: Claims daily new jobs; operational shift lifecycle
pay_schedule_language: Up to EUR 20/hour claim; schedules and job categories are prominent
trust_strength: Large claimed workforce and operational employer relationships
strategic_gap: Student-centered and operationally heavy; neutral cross-source flexible-job discovery is not the main product

primary_scope: Students in Berlin and Brandenburg; non-academic casual work
supply_model: Commercial and private employer submissions with manual review
candidate_experience_observed: Minimal bilingual list/detail experience; 15 current jobs observed
pay_schedule_language: Remuneration field exists; schedule depth varies by poster
trust_strength: Manual review and clear operator identity
business_model_observed: EUR 60 plus VAT/30 days for commercial jobs; private jobs free
strategic_gap: Trusted and focused but tiny supply, student-only and weak matching; already owns the 30-day claim

primary_scope: Minijobs, part-time, student and entry roles
supply_model: Employer posts plus direct partners/external sources
candidate_experience_observed: Many filters and pay/hour cards, but observed results mixed surveys, travel fundraising and full-time weeks
freshness_observed: 30-day products; ranking decays with age but paid/partner priority affects order
pay_schedule_language: Often shows wage and weekly hours; schedule specificity varies
trust_strength: Employer accounts and anti-discrimination guidance; mixed-source inventory
business_model_observed: Free new-customer offer; EUR 179 standard and EUR 358 top 30-day products; application charges can apply to intro offer
strategic_gap: High inventory but weak niche purity and commercial clutter

candidate_experience_observed: Very simple search and city pages; 1,440 Berlin jobs observed; visible mix skewed professional/technical
freshness_observed: New jobs shown daily with visible dates
pay_schedule_language: Language is core; schedule and hourly-pay discovery are not
trust_strength: Report-job controls and named EU operator
business_model_observed: EUR 99/month one active job; EUR 149/month unlimited for one employer
strategic_gap: Solves language discovery, not flexible-entry work or schedule fit

primary_scope: Primarily tech, design and English-friendly Germany roles
candidate_experience_observed: Simple structured form and direct application URL
freshness_observed: Employer-managed posting; no special liveness promise observed
pay_schedule_language: Supports temporary type and tags; schedule-first browsing not core
strategic_gap: Useful English/tech niche, but not a local flexible-work product

candidate_experience_observed: Simple category-led board with email/social distribution
business_model_observed: EUR 120 standard/90 days; EUR 300 featured; EUR 50 internships
strategic_gap: Strong niche identity but mostly professional startup roles and very long listing duration

supply_model: Employer creates once; JOIN publishes to organic/paid boards and manages candidates
candidate_experience_observed: Not a candidate destination thesis; excellent employer workflow
freshness_observed: Syncs changes from source across destinations
pay_schedule_language: Structured job creation and pipeline; schedule fields depend on employer
trust_strength: Centralized source tracking, candidate pipeline and GDPR tooling
business_model_observed: From EUR 20 per active job/month after trial; paid media extra
strategic_gap: Potential partner/infrastructure rather than direct competitor; demonstrates how cheap distribution software has become

primary_scope: Broad German hiring with focus on measurable candidates
candidate_experience_observed: Mobile candidate funnels and assessment; employer campaign product
pay_schedule_language: Structured screening; job-specific pay/schedule depends on employer
business_model_observed: HIRE base price EUR 400; REACH can be under EUR 150/job
strategic_gap: Far more expensive and campaign-led; does not organize the consumer market around flexible availability
